title: Runtime DLL provenance inventory
scope: DLLs in Habumi-Native-Vulkan/runtime/bin release profile, cross-checked against candidate runtime/bin and installed MSYS2 CLANGARM64 binaries
limitations: Only exact SHA-256 matches to installed MSYS2 binaries are attributed as verified MSYS2 release binaries. Candidate package metadata is separately identified when hashes differ.
Android platform-tools match the installed SDK version 37.0.0-14910828 byte-for-byte, including adb.exe and both DLLs. Mesa attribution records the pinned third-party release asset.

Every DLL has license text references. Missing local package texts were supplemented with standard licenses or identified upstream texts; copyright and full dependency source auditing remain incomplete.
Native renderer hash is the isolated release build, intentionally different from the development profile.
Generic GPL in the gmp package metadata has no version; GPL-2.0 and GPL-3.0 standard texts are included as references without mapping one to a specific file or binary component.
The lz4 package metadata covers both BSD and GPL material; the upstream v1.10.0 lib/LICENSE is the BSD-2-Clause text for lib/ sources, while the repository distinguishes non-library tools separately.
